anti_bias_axis.evidence: Explorers declare an explicit methodology and source-corpus composite; reviewers declare the canonical attack-vector axis.

clone_detection.evidence: Each explorer and reviewer pair differs in at least two primary methodological or attack nouns and verbs.

spread.evidence: Explorer lanes use formal structure, temporal causality, and learner-centered visualization; reviewer lanes use precedent, counterexample, and definitional analysis.

pairwise_evidence.evidence: Both groups declare all three unordered pairs and each statement identifies the two approaches, relevant axis, and reciprocal exposure.

global_coherence.evidence: The two fan-out groups are locally tense and jointly coherent with the global anti-bias statement.
